## 2. Avoid

- **Also avoid:** Generic DevOps bullets with no model-serving scope

## 3. Types that do not apply

- **Model / model family:** platform role: serves models, does not choose them
- **Business & product:** cost governance is covered by capacity planning
- **Domain knowledge:** domain-agnostic
- **Research craft:** not expected

## 4. Credentials (tie-breakers, not skills)

- **Optional:** Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA): not in the corpus; common in platform hiring
- **Optional:** AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer – Associate (MLA-C01): MLOps-oriented associate credential [T0-11]

## 5. Prerequisites and proof

- **Prerequisites:** Backend, DevOps or SRE background; India GCCs use the MLOps Engineer title (Taggd, C).
- **Proof to show:** A self-hosted vLLM/SGLang cluster with continuous synthetic load benchmarks, automated failover, dynamic LoRA routing and Grafana dashboards.
- **Posting terms (measured or cited):** MLOps, LLMOps, Kubernetes (69.4% of DevOps postings), Terraform (59.1%), CI/CD (81.2%), model serving, KServe, monitoring.
